title: Long GLD — Iran Escalation + Fed Credibility Tail
entry: Buy any pullback to $410-$415 (gold spot $4,400-$4,450). If gold breaks $4,550, add on the breakout — trend acceleration signal.
stop_loss: $398 daily close (gold spot $4,290) — implies Iran ceasefire holds AND Fed dovish pivot
catalyst: Iran ceasefire 'on life support' per Trump's rejection of counter-offer as 'garbage' (May 11-12). Strait of Hormuz blockade tail keeps oil at $90-100. Fed credibility risk: 8-4 hawkish vote with Warsh inheriting June 16-17 FOMC raises 'will they actually hike' uncertainty.
thesis: Gold is the cleanest hedge for two simultaneous tail risks that other assets can't isolate. (1) Iran war escalation: if the Strait of Hormuz blockade extends beyond mid-June, oil hits $130+ and gold runs as the inflation hedge of last resort. Brent already at $107 with WTI at $98 — both up 45%+ since the war began Feb 28. (2) Fed credibility: an 8-4 hawkish vote with rising hike odds creates a scenario where the Fed either hikes into a slowing economy (recession risk, gold benefits) OR doesn't hike despite hot inflation (credibility loss, gold benefits). Both paths are gold-positive; only a clean Iran de-escalation AND cool PCE breaks the trade. Gold has historically held during both inflation regimes and risk-off regimes — uncorrelated to AI/semi book. Sized at 4% it's portfolio insurance: caps drawdown if the macro picture deteriorates while AI longs are exposed.
bull_case: Iran-Israel diplomatic talks collapse (high probability per Trump's public rhetoric); Strait of Hormuz blockade extends through July; Brent breaks $130; WTI breaks $115; April PCE prints 3.7%+ YoY on May 27; CPI sticky into June. Gold spot to $5,000-$5,200 within 2 months. GLD to $465-$485. Real yields fall as nominal yields rise less than inflation; gold's classic regime.
bear_case: Iran ceasefire actually holds and gets formalized; Strait of Hormuz fully reopens by mid-June; WTI drops to $80-85; oil-driven inflation rolls over fast. April PCE cool at 3.2%; Warsh signals patience at June FOMC; gold sells off as 'tail risk hedge' premium unwinds. Gold spot to $4,200; GLD to $400. -4% drawdown but capped by the long-duration central bank demand floor.
invalidation: Daily close below $398 (gold spot below $4,290) — requires both Iran de-escalation confirmed AND PCE cool
